query:
UPDATE public.planned_trips SET
            label                = $1,
            estimated_km         = $2,
            start_date           = $3,
            end_date             = $4,
            recurrence           = $5,
            recurrence_interval  = $6,
            days_of_week         = $7,
            day_of_month         = $8,
            recurrence_end_date  = $9,
            active               = $10
        WHERE id = $11 AND vehicle_id = $12
